evidence.observation: Pressure has risen steadily during growth: 3.044 → 3.070 → 3.122 → 3.209 Torr. During the ramp it held flat at about 2.95–2.98 Torr.
Exhaust O2 has risen during growth: 12.0 → 16.0 → 20.7 → 27.2 ppm. It was about 6–8 ppm during the ramp. Air getting in fits this; a blocked exhaust would not raise O2.
Argon flow is steady at about 100 sccm, so the pressure rise isn't coming from the gas feed.
Temperature settled at 750 °C after a brief overshoot to 759.8 °C, so thermal control looks normal.

args.missing_evidence: A leak-up check (isolate the pump and watch the pressure rise rate) or a helium leak test on the tube flanges would confirm the seal leak. No characterization of the sample exists yet.
